card.name: Digit 1 inside table numbers
card.fires_on: The digit "1" appearing as the first digit of a multi-digit number, usually right after an opening parenthesis or a decimal, in adverse-reaction counts and percentages or in data tables.

modes.label: Patient counts in parentheses
modes.description: The digit 1 begins a count or percentage inside parentheses after a patient number.

modes.label: Fractions in tables
modes.description: The digit 1 begins the numerator of a fraction such as 11/208 in a lab-results table.

modes.label: Numbers in data tables
modes.description: The digit 1 starts a number within rows of dosimetry or range values.

card.plain: It marks the leading digit 1 of a number in a table or in patient-count percentages, where more digits follow.
